title: Compare dormant receiver transition identity independent of JSON member order
outcome: Valid predecessor rows with different JSON member order can use the dormant full-to-compact transition with exact retained identity.
acceptance: A disposable successor fixture accepts an equivalent reordered predecessor identity on a full-to-compact update and refuses a changed identity.
Identity comparison preserves exact unsigned generation values and canonical identity fields.
The correction stays in the dormant successor fixture and carries no live migration or retirement writer.
